name: Melancholy Lake
source:
Two girls go on a date in the middle of a violent, collapsing world. Despite their contrasting temperaments, Holly and Isabel carve out a fragile pocket of tenderness, using each other as refuge from everything around them.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4744310/Melancholy_Lake__Camocipher12_Shorts/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
两个女孩在一个暴力、崩溃的世界中约会。尽管霍莉和伊莎贝尔的性格截然不同，但她们却都散发着脆弱的温柔，将彼此当作躲避周围一切的避难所。
